sample_unit: inpatient records (Yale New Haven Health System, over 13,000 unique records)

links.outcome: Prevalence and persistence of training-data memorization, including sensitive clinical content, in medical LLMs
links.effect: Memorization was prevalent and significantly higher than in the general domain; up to 87% of content memorized during continued pretraining remained after fine-tuning; harmful memorization included sensitive clinical content.
links.quote: The results demonstrate that memorization is prevalent and significantly higher than that in the general domain.

screen.reason: Evaluates privacy and memorization risks (safety/confidentiality characteristics) of medical LLMs trained/fine-tuned on clinical datasets, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard intervention.
